item.question: What are the optimal wavelength ranges for creating repulsive optical potentials in dysprosium Bose-Einstein condensates?
item.answer: The study identifies two optimal spectral regions for creating repulsive potentials in dysprosium Bose-Einstein condensates: approximately 402-404 nm and 415-418 nm.
